fuel_consumption.source_quote: As of December 31, 2023, we have hedged 30% of our projected fuel requirement for the first quarter of 2024.

instrument_type_details.notes: 2,706 thousand barrels at Dec 31 2023 (2,706k x 42 = 113.652M gallons). Instruments are call option spread agreements. Q1 30%, Q2 16%, Q3 3%, Q4 5% hedged. Actual 2023 consumption hedged was 25%. Asset fair value $4M.

throughput.source_quote: Aircraft fuel and related taxes $2,720M; average fuel price $3.03/gallon in 2023; implied consumption = $2,720M / $3.03 = 898M gallons (from Item 7 Aircraft Fuel section; text also notes 55M gallon increase vs 2022)

warnings: Volume converted from 2,706 thousand barrels x 42 = 113.652M gallons; coverage varies by quarter (Q1 30%, Q2 16%, Q3 3%, Q4 5%); no single annual pct provided; volume_pct_of_consumption computed as 113.652M / 806M projected 2024 consumption (from Item 7A sensitivity: $244M / (10% x $3.03/gal) = 806M) = 0.141
